result.summary: Type E revalidation/closure design declared for GitHub #364 / ISS-0106. The existing src/design/fix-ISS-0106.md matches the current main implementation exactly: build.zig's test-integration step wires ~19+ sibling Run steps through a new intermediate barrier step (test-integration-others-internal); a dedicated second Run step (run_iss503_integration_tests_after_others) carries the barrier ordering edge onto test_integration_step, leaving the pre-existing narrow zig build test-integration-iss503 step unaffected. The implementation matches the design verbatim. No code changes are required; only fresh evidence (zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, zig build test-integration-iss503, and a full zig build test-integration run showing zero ISS-503 identifiers in any deadlock/failure window) is needed to close #364. Sleep, retry-on-40P01, timeout inflation, COUNT-query locking, pg-driver changes, and global serialization are explicitly rejected as non-solutions. tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig is documentation-only for this closure; the existing doc-comment block already cross-references ISS-0106/#364 and the barrier.
result.design_classification_rationale: Single Type E — issue is build-graph/dependency-ordering design plus a documentation comment, not a CRUD endpoint, list page, migration, or React Flow node. The existing prose artefact at src/design/fix-ISS-0106.md already captures every required element (module purpose, public interface, error taxonomy, callers/scripts impacted, DAG diagram, non-solutions). No new parameter file is generated.
implementation_files_required: build.zig (revalidation surface only; no behavioral change expected — current commit 35471e7 already implements the design)
explicit_non_solutions: No sleep calls anywhere on the test path.
No retry-on-40P01 / deadlock-retry wrappers around any query, including db_integration_test.zig's COUNT(*).
No inflation of lock_timeout or deadlock_timeout as a workaround.
No advisory-lock wrapping of db_integration_test.zig's COUNT(*) or TestHarness.init() call alone (insufficient — does not cover ISS-503's raw external connection).

No change to vendor/pg/pg.zig driver behavior (no retry path, no error-swallowing, no pool-level conversion to empty success — pg.zig's readUntilReady() returns PgError.ServerError after ErrorResponse).
No global serialization of all ~19+ test-integration binaries (over-reach; only the single raw-DDL outlier needs to be ordered).

gates_required: zig build test-integration-iss503 (focused ISS-503 target — confirms barrier-respected serial path passes independently)
zig build test-integration (full umbrella — confirms TC-DB-01-01 and TC-DB-01-02 acceptance behavior PASSES, and that zero ISS-503 identifiers appear in any deadlock/failure window)
evidence_collection: Case-insensitive scan of the complete zig build test-integration log for 'iss503', 'iss_503', 'ISS-503', 'test_iss503', 'test-integration-iss503', 'iss503_rls_removal'. Expected: zero matches in any deadlock/failure window. Matches in the 'completed successfully' part of the ISS-503 step itself are expected; matches in any other binary's error context are not.

Direct confirmation in build-step tree that the ISS-503 binary (run_iss503_integration_tests_after_others) is scheduled AFTER test_integration_others_step and BEFORE test_integration_step closes. Expected ordering: test_integration_others_step → run_iss503_integration_tests_after_others → test_integration_step. (In some runner outputs the barrier step itself does not appear as an entry; the proof is that the ISS-503 Run step is not started before its siblings complete.)
Assertion-level confirmation: db_integration_test.zig's TC-DB-01-01 and TC-DB-01-02 expected(n > 0) lines must observe n > 0 across multiple runs.
abort_conditions: If any gate above returns non-zero, OR any ISS-503 identifier appears in another binary's deadlock/failure window, this design is invalidated — open a rework cycle and route back to ISSUE-FIXER.
If the build-step tree shows ISS-503 starting concurrently with any sibling, this design is invalidated.
